sarah_ml: FYI bringing up hf model 'falcon-xyz-finetuned' on staging. Tokenizer conversion script succeeded but evals show tokenization shift on multi-turn chat templates.
sarah_ml: Error pattern: some system messages get split differently, causing role tokens to misalign. Suspect tokenizer.json vs tokenizer_config.json mismatch (fast vs slow mismatch / missing files).
keegan_infra: Can you paste the tokenizer dir? often fast tokenizers have tokenizer.json + tokenizer_config.json that disagree on special_tokens_map.
sarah_ml: /mnt/models/falcon-xyz/tokenizer/
keegan_infra: build-bot: conversion-log for falcon-xyz -> redwood format
build-bot: ```
Converting tokenizer... found tokenizer.json
tokenizer_config.json not found
fallback to slow tokenizer constructor
WARNING: 'bos_token' missing in tokenizer_config, using '<s>' from tokenizer.json
Saved redwood_tokenizer => /opt/redwood/tokenizers/falcon-xyz/
``` 
tomas_tokenizer: That's the classic case: huggingface fast tokenizer's tokenizer.json contains merged behavior, but tokenizer_config.json (if present) can specify different special tokens. If tokenizer_config.json is missing, our conversion may infer defaults and produce a slow tokenizer that doesn't match fast's offsets.
ashley_research: We saw similar before in quantization A/B. Off-by-one tokens made evaluations drop ~3% on our unit prompts.
sarah_ml: Repro steps I used:
1) hf_hub_download to get model repo
2) run tools/hf-to-redwood.py --tokenizer /mnt/models/falcon-xyz/tokenizer
3) start redwood local server
4) run evals/chat_templates/regression_suite
Result: mismatches in role prefix tokenization.
keegan_infra: Quick local hack: force rebuild slow tokenizer from tokenizer.json by running:
```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
from transformers import PreTrainedTokenizerFast
# load fast file
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer/tokenizer.json')
ptk = PreTrainedTokenizerFast(tokenizer_object=t, bos_token='<s>', eos_token='</s>')
ptk.save_pretrained('redwood_tokenizer/')
```
That creates a PreTrainedTokenizerFast wrapper we can use as slow for our pipeline.
tomas_tokenizer: Slightly better: parse special_tokens_map from tokenizer.json's "special_tokens_map": ... and ensure tokenizer_config.json is created with {"bos_token":"<s>","eos_token":"</s>","unk_token":"<unk>"} so downstream code picks them up.
ashley_research: Also add unit test: load converted tokenizer and run a set of canonical prompts; assert token ids equal to HF fast tokenizer.
sarah_ml: Taking action: I'll add test + update conversion script to emit tokenizer_config.json if missing and create ticket INF-2147. Also pinned quantization jobs to previous model until we validate.
keegan_infra: I'll add a CI check in eng-ml that fails if tokenizer.json exists but tokenizer_config.json missing OR special_tokens differ.
sarah_ml: Thanks. small follow-up: can someone paste the exact code to extract special_tokens_map from tokenizer.json? I tried jq but structure's nested.
tomas_tokenizer: quick jq snippet:
```
jq '.model.special_tokens_map' tokenizer/tokenizer.json
```
works for our fast tokenizers.
sarah_ml: perfect. tagging this thread to INF-2147 and moving to a follow-up doc. :thumbsup:
